Type II muscle fibers are more focused on strength. They have less endurance, but more raw power capabilities. This category can be further divided into Type IIa and Type IIb. Type IIa is going to be better at explosive movements that last longer like sprinting, and Type IIb is going to be better at short, powerful movements like deadlifting.
